bsci_agent_monorail_dcb.maker: Boston Scientific (balloon manufactured by Hemoteq AG for BSC)
bsci_agent_monorail_dcb.product: AGENT Paclitaxel-Coated PTCA Balloon Catheter (AGENT DCB), Monorail
bsci_agent_monorail_dcb.device_type: coronary DCB (paclitaxel/ATBC, 2 ug/mm2; semi-compliant, built on Emerge balloon platform)
bsci_agent_monorail_dcb.generation_notes: Current and only generation. FDA-approved Apr 2024 for coronary in-stent restenosis (US); CE-marked earlier (OUS 2015 spec sheet IC-236507-AB). BSC EU page lists a 40 mm length added 2025 ('limited sizes'); the 2026 US catalog does not list it. 24-month shelf life.

sizes.matrix_notes: Full 7 x 4 matrix = 28 sizes (every diameter in every length) per BSC OUS spec sheet and 2026 US catalog. Nominal 6 atm; rated burst 14 atm (2.0-3.0 mm) and 12 atm (3.5-4.0 mm). A 40 mm length exists in limited sizes per BSC EU product page (not itemised in any document I could read). All inventory sizes seen (2.00-4.00 x 15/20/30; 2.25x20; 2.5x15; 2.75x30) are valid; '2.00 x ?' is a valid diameter.
sizes.other: Rapid-exchange (Monorail), 5F guide compatible (guide ID >= 0.056 in / 1.42 mm), 0.014 in guidewire, shaft OD 1.67 mm, lesion entry profile 0.017 in (0.43 mm), crossing profile 0.91-1.14 mm, marks at 90 cm and 100 cm. Supplied with a CLIPIT hypotube clip; 1 per carton.

bsci_agent_monorail_dcb.ref_scheme: US: H749 39608 <LL><DD> 0 where LL = balloon length (12/15/20/30) and DD = diameter code (20,22,25,27,30,35,40); OUS/CE: H749 39222 <DD> <LL> 0 (14-digit form H74939222<DD>01210 etc.).

carton.basis: Not found in GUDID, BSC literature or distributor listings. The only figure is the operator's own measurement carried in inventory_a.json (15 x 230 x 250 mm, thickness x spine x face). Reseller listings give no usable weights.

images.shows: Front face of the carton (viewed straight on): 'AGENT' wordmark top-left, cyan-to-blue gradient with drug-particle spray and balloon tip, BSC logo top-right, white label strip at bottom. Face is near-square.

bsci_agent_monorail_dcb.inventory_corrections: None needed: brand, type and sizes are right. Add: sizes are 2.00-4.00 x 12/15/20/30 (12 mm also exists; 40 mm limited/new). Inventory 'which_end_up' notes are consistent with the BSC convention (MR green end, BSC wordmark end).

bsci_nc_emerge_monorail.product: NC EMERGE Monorail PTCA Dilatation Catheter
bsci_nc_emerge_monorail.device_type: coronary non-compliant (NC) balloon for post-dilatation of stents / high-pressure dilatation
bsci_nc_emerge_monorail.generation_notes: Current generation (Emerge platform, 2015-era design; IC-329213 DEC2015 ordering table). Replaced NC Quantum Apex. Same platform is used for the Wolverine cutting balloon and the Agent DCB. Companion semi-compliant Emerge Monorail also exists (pre-dilatation).

sizes.matrix_notes: Monorail matrix (BSC product page): 2.00-4.00 mm (0.25 steps) in 6, 8, 12, 15, 20, 30 mm lengths; 4.50 and 5.00 mm in 6, 8, 12, 15, 20 mm (no 30); 5.50 and 6.00 mm in 8, 12, 15, 20 mm (no 6, no 30). 2026 US catalog lists the 12/15/20/30 mm Monorail families (30 mm only to 4.00 mm). Shelf carton 5.50 x 12 is a valid size (REF H7493926712550). OTW version exists with the same matrix (REF prefix H74939268).
sizes.other: Rapid exchange, 143 cm effective length (2026 US catalog). 0.014 in wire, platinum-iridium markers. Rated burst pressure not read from a primary source here.

bsci_nc_emerge_monorail.ref_scheme: Monorail: H749 39267 <LL><DD> 0, with LL = balloon length (06,08,12,15,20,30) and DD = diameter x10 or code (20,22,25,27,30,32,35,37,40,45,50,55,60); e.g. 15 mm x 3.00 = H749 392671530 0 and website 14-digit form H7493926712550 = 12 mm x 5.50. OTW uses prefix 39268.

bsci_wolverine_cutting_balloon.device_type: coronary scoring/cutting balloon (atherotomes; for balloon-resistant lesions)
bsci_wolverine_cutting_balloon.generation_notes: Current generation, built on the NC EMERGE platform (spec sheet IC-413305-AF 2024). Resellers still list the older FLEXTOME cutting balloon (Quantum Apex-based predecessor) with the same 6/10/15 mm blade lengths; the Wolverine is the successor.

sizes.matrix_notes: Full 9 x 3 matrix = 27 sizes. Rated burst 12 atm, nominal 6 atm. Guide: 2.00-3.25 mm need >= 0.056 in (5F); 3.50-4.00 mm need >= 0.066 in (6F). Crossing profile 0.037 in (0.93 mm), tip entry 0.017 in. All 12 inventory sizes seen are valid (6 mm length also exists but was not seen).

bsci_mach1_guiding_catheter.generation_notes: Current BSC guide catheter (2026 US catalog lists it with Runway guides). REF H749 34357661 0 read in the inventory = JL3.5, 7F (verified in the catalog). Inventory 'MP1 7F' carton = H749 3435738 0.

sizes.matrix_notes: French size / ID: 6F 0.070 in, 7F 0.081 in, 8F 0.091 in (guide catheters have no balloon diameter/length). Standard shaft length 100 cm; brachial BR1 80 cm; IM 85/90 cm; some 8F curves 90 cm. Curves by size (2026 US catalog; SH = side holes, ST = short tip): JUDKINS LEFT 6F: JL3, 3.5, 4, 4.5, 5, 6, 3.5SH, 4SH; 7F: JL3, 3.5, 4, 4.5, 5, 6 + SH versions of 3-5; 8F: same + JL4 90cm. JUDKINS RIGHT 6F: JR3-6, JR3.5SH, JR4SH; 7F: JR3-5 + SH; 8F: JR3-5 + SH + 90 cm. AMPLATZ LEFT AL.75/1/1.5/2/3 (6F, 7F, 8F, also ST and SH); AMPLATZ RIGHT AR1, AR2 (+SH) 6/7/8F; ALLRIGHT ART3, 3.5, 4 (+SH, ART4.5 6F); CLS3-4.5; FCL/FCR3.5-4; FL3-6 (+ST, SH); FR3-5; Hockey Stick; IM; KIESZ KL/KR; Left Back-up; LCB/RCB bypass; MP1, MP2 (6/7/8F); Q-curve 3.5-5; Shepherd's Crook RC3.5/4 SC; VODA Right VR1/VR2; VODA Left VL3-5; radial: KIMNY, KIMNY MINI, MANN IM, MUTA ML3-4.5, Radial, Radial ST, RBL3.5-4.5, RBR3-4. Complete per-curve table is in the catalog (pp. 22-29).
sizes.other: Large lumen; 7F is the most common hospital size. Radial/brachial curves are 6F (some 7F).

boston_scientific_mustang.device_type: PTA balloon, non-compliant, 0.035 in OTW, up to 24 atm rated burst (NyBax balloon)
boston_scientific_mustang.generation_notes: Current generation (launched ~2011; brochure PI-225202-AB OCT2017). Indicated for iliac, femoral, popliteal, tibial, peroneal, subclavian, renal, AV dialysis fistulae and (to 120 mm) biliary strictures; not for coronary.

sizes.matrix_notes: 203 catalogue codes (matches BSC's '203 codes'). Diameters 3-8 mm: lengths 20,30,40,60,80,100,120,150,180,200 mm. 9, 10 and 12 mm: lengths 20,30,40,60,80 mm only. Shaft lengths 40, 75, 135 cm; every size is offered at 75 and 135 cm; 40 cm shaft exists for lengths <= 100 mm (5, 6 mm to 120 mm), and the >= 120 mm 3, 4, 7, 8 mm sizes are 75/135 only. Sheath: 3-7 mm = 5F; 8, 9, 10 mm = 6F; 12 mm = 7F. Rated burst: 3-5 mm 24 atm; 6 mm 22-24; 7-8 mm 18-20; 9 mm 18; 10 and 12 mm 14. Every inventory size read (e.g. 12.0x20/135 7F, 10.0x20/135 6F, 9.0x20/135 6F, 8.0x80/75, 6.0x60/75) matches a valid code.
sizes.other: Tip entry 0.040 in; fits 0.035 in guidewire; 7x200 through 5F and 10x80 through 6F per brochure. Full diameter x length x shaft table with UPN in the product-code brochure.

boston_scientific_mustang.ref_scheme: UPN H749 39171 <DD><LL/10><S> 0 where DD = 2-digit diameter (03..12), LL/10 = 2-digit balloon length in cm-tens (02=20 mm ... 20=200 mm), S = shaft digit (4 = 40 cm, 7 = 75 cm, 1 = 135 cm). Old catalog number 39171-DDLLS.

carton.basis: Not found. The photos show a flat, near-square front (about 0.8-0.85 w:h) and a thin spine; no mm figure published. Reseller weights are placeholders.

boston_scientific_synergy_xd.product: SYNERGY XD Everolimus-Eluting Platinum Chromium Coronary Stent System (Monorail)
boston_scientific_synergy_xd.device_type: coronary DES (PtCr, abluminal bioabsorbable PLGA polymer, everolimus)
boston_scientific_synergy_xd.generation_notes: Current generation (XD = 'Xtra Deliverability' update to the original SYNERGY; original SYNERGY spec sheet lists 2.25-4.0 mm x 8-38 mm with a different black/gray carton). SYNERGY MEGATRON is the separate large-vessel 3.5-5.0 mm line. 2026 US catalog.

sizes.matrix_notes: 2026 US catalog: 2.25 mm: 8,12,16,20,24,28,32,38; 2.50, 2.75, 3.00, 3.50, 4.00 mm: 8,12,16,20,24,28,32,38,48; 4.50 mm: 12,16,20,24,28,32; 5.00 mm: 12,16,20,24,28,32. Nominal 11 atm; rated burst 18 atm (2.25-2.75) or 16 atm (3.0-5.0). Original SYNERGY spec sheet (older) lists only 2.25-4.0 mm x 8-38 mm and an OTW version (H74939261xx). Inventory note about labels '4.0 .. 80' on lying boxes does not match any SYNERGY XD size: lengths top out at 48 mm, so the label text is likely misread (possibly 4.0 x 28 or x 38).
sizes.other: Rapid exchange, 144 cm delivery system, wire exit about 25 cm from tip, 0.014 in guidewire, guide ID >= 0.056 in (5F) for the original SYNERGY; tip profile 0.017 in; average stent profile 0.039 in (2.50 mm).

carton.basis: Not found. Photos show an almost square front face (width about equal to height). Reseller listing shows 5 lb, which is a placeholder shipping weight, not a carton weight; not used.

Front of the OLDER original SYNERGY (non-XD) Monorail carton: black/gray front with stent graphic, orange 'bioabsorbable polymer' roundel, PtCr logo, size roundel 2.50 x 16, green MR corner. Not the XD artwork.

boston_scientific_synergy_xd.inventory_corrections: Name and type correct. The '4.0 .. 80' label reading is not a valid size (max length 48 mm). Add the 4.5 and 5.0 mm diameters and the 48 mm length.

boston_scientific_v18_control_wire.product: V-18 ControlWire (and V-14 ControlWire) guidewires, ICE hydrophilic coating, straight shapeable tip
boston_scientific_v18_control_wire.device_type: peripheral guidewire (0.018 in V-18, 0.014 in V-14); not a coronary device
boston_scientific_v18_control_wire.generation_notes: Current BSC peripheral wires (EU page PI-572505-AA, US page PI-343640-AA SEP2015). Older boxes are branded 'Boston Scientific MEDI-TECH' with model codes V18/12/300 and catalog 46-860 (white box). Shelf box says 'V-18 Control Wire' with a yellow '018' tab and magenta '014' for V-14.

sizes.matrix_notes: Wire diameter 0.014 in (0.36 mm) for V-14 and 0.018 in (0.46 mm) for V-18. V-14: 182 and 300 cm, short or long taper, straight (shapeable) or angled tip, 3 g / 6 g tip loads. V-18: 110, 150, 200 and 300 cm, short or long taper, straight (shapeable) tip, 6 g / 8 g tip loads. Shelf-photo sizes (V-14 x 300, V-18 x 300, V-18 x 200) are valid; the label 'short taper' vs 'long taper' is a separate variant (taper length 8 cm short, 12 cm long).
sizes.other: Wire: V-14 UPNs listed on the EU page: H74939216718210 (short, 182, straight), ...18220 (angled), ...30010/30020 (short, 300), long taper H74939216918210/18220/30010/30020. V-18 retail catalog numbers: 46-850 (150 cm short), 46-852 (200 cm short), 46-854 (300 cm short, M001468540), 46-858 (200 cm long, M001468580), 46-860 (300 cm long, M001468600). A full V-18 UPN table was not found in a primary document.

boston_scientific_v18_control_wire.ref_scheme: V-18: legacy catalog 46-8xx / M0014 68xx0 (e.g. 46-854 = M001468540). V-14: UPN H749 39216 7/9 <length> <tip> 0 (e.g. H74939216730010). No current V-18 UPN table was found.

unknown_teal_boston_style.product: SYNERGY MEGATRON Everolimus-Eluting Platinum Chromium Coronary Stent System, Monorail (probable)
unknown_teal_boston_style.generation_notes: Identification is by elimination plus carton-face match, not by readable text. Evidence: (1) the layout is identical to the neighbouring orange SYNERGY XD spine (cap, white body with vertical dark bar and black size cell, dark green MR block); (2) one carton leans out in the shot and shows a dark gray/teal upper front with a white lower label, matching the Megatron front artwork (gray field, teal stent ring, white label strip, bioabsorbable-polymer roundel) shown on reseller photos; (3) BSC colour-codes the SYNERGY family (orange = XD) and Megatron is the only other current SYNERGY product in the 2026 US catalog. Caveat: the faint '3.0/' cell read in the inventory does not fit Megatron (sizes start at 3.50), but the cell is too small to trust; and I found no photo of a Megatron spine to confirm the teal colour. Confidence in the family is moderate, in the exact variant low.

sizes.matrix_notes: 2026 US catalog: 3.50, 4.00, 4.50, 5.00 mm, each in 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32 mm (28 sizes). Nominal 11 atm, rated burst 16 atm. Delivery system 144 cm.
sizes.other: Intended for large proximal vessels (3.5-5.0 mm; overexpansion to 6 mm class). Rapid exchange.
